obligations.expected_behavior: Every applicable Consumer executes enable through a real call surface.
forbidden_result: Enable is performed only through a simulated, indirect, or nonexistent call surface.
obligations.observable_result: A real call surface records a completed enable operation for each applicable Consumer.
obligations.state_after: The applicable Consumer has completed enable through a real call surface.

obligations.subject: Each applicable Consumer
obligations.trigger: The FR-10 enable/disable/rollback/re-enable flow is executed.
